plan: Drive: from Soda Creek, about 151 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).

Walk: 5.4 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 43 m, about 112 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
